message: `{name}[..]`: slicing is single-dimension-only, so a `[lo:hi]` slice cannot be combined with an index or applied to a 2-D vector net
description: Slices are supported for 1-D vector nets only, and an access can slice or index, but not both.
actions: Index every dimension, for example `{name}[0][0]`, or slice a 1-D vector net.
